name: Satou Tsugunobu
source:
A warrior from the late Heian period. She is one of Yoshitsune's Four Heavenly Kings. She has an earnest and straightforward personality, she's perhaps even a little too serious at times. She is not only skilled in martial arts, but is also well-read in various texts, which is remarkable for the Heian period when literacy rates were extremely low.
